tiles.title: Core
tiles.desc: HTTP and stdio transports, API keys, OAuth 2.1 with Google sign-in, roles, an audit log and secret masking in logs.

tiles.title: Plugins
tiles.desc: One connector each: its tools, the env vars it needs and its permission group.

tiles.title: Gateway
tiles.desc: Proxies other MCP servers (GitHub's, Notion's, yours) under a name prefix. Read-only by default.

tiles.title: Store
tiles.desc: Keys, users, OAuth tokens, plugin state and the audit log. A SQLite file by default, Supabase optional.

tiles.title: Google Drive
tiles.desc: Search, read and list files. Semantic search over a Qdrant index with OpenAI embeddings.

tiles.title: Slack
tiles.desc: List and read channels, find and fetch files. Full-text search with a user token.

tiles.title: GitHub
tiles.desc: A repository tree, plus GitHub's own remote MCP tools as github_*, read-only.

tiles.title: Railway
tiles.desc: Services, deployments and logs. Secrets in logs are masked.
